# infoblox_credential_group (List Resource)

Retrieves a list of Infoblox CredentialGroup from the NIOS backend.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// List specific Credential Groups using filters
list "infoblox_credential_group" "list_credential_group_using_filters" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    filters = {
      name = "example_credential_group"
    }
  }
  limit = 10
}

// List Credential Groups with resource details included
list "infoblox_credential_group" "list_credential_group_with_resource" {
  provider         = infoblox
  include_resource = true
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filters are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes (e.g. name, view). If multiple filters are specified, only resources that match all of them are returned.
